description: This file defines the DCount class, which implements the DCOUNT function for database calculations within PHPSpreadsheet. It provides logic to count cells containing numbers in a specified database column that meet particular criteria.

classes.name: DCount
classes.description: A class implementing the DCOUNT database function for spreadsheet calculations, counting the number of numerical entries in a filtered dataset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the count of cells with numbers in a specified database column that satisfy given criteria, optionally returning an error if the field is invalid.
